title: Tool error not recovered: read_file_range on persisted-output outside allowed roots
description: read_file_range was called with an absolute path to the start_spec overflow result file saved at C:\Users\Simeon\.claude\projects\...\toolu_0184Y3sLrwrXGvPRQQYBEZAE.json. The call failed because that path is outside the allowed roots (project root: e:\Code\Moeb, temp dir: C:\Users\Simeon\AppData\Local\Temp\). The native Read tool was used as a fallback before Phase 1 to read the file in chunks. This caused a RunState tool error which failed the tool-errors rubric criterion.
proposed_resolution: Investigate whether start_spec and start_run can be modified to persist overflow output files to the OS temp directory rather than the Claude projects directory, so moeb's read_file_range with absolute: true can access them without requiring external Read tool fallback.
